name: FNCE 5408
title: Valuation of Financial Assets
description: Developing models for asset allocation, and security selection to construct a diversified portfolio. Analysis of industry segments, and valuation of common stocks and bonds. Topics include analysis of business models, measurement of risk and cost of capital, valuation of common stocks, and valuation and measurement of risk of bonds and bond funds. Preparation of analysts' reports is an integral part of the course.
requirement_description: FNCE 5101 or FNCE 5182; open to MBA students, others with consent.
